nombre: visitante: RLS deniega las 21 tablas aun con SELECT temporal
sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA clinical,ml TO anon; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA clinical,ml TO anon; SELECT qa.identity(1,'paciente'); SET LOCAL ROLE anon; DO $$ DECLARE t record; n bigint; BEGIN FOR t IN SELECT schemaname,tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname IN ('clinical','ml') LOOP EXECUTE format('SELECT count(*) FROM %I.%I',t.schemaname,t.tablename) INTO n; ASSERT n=0; END LOOP; END $$;
